name: solution-hero
description: Solution-page hero: copy, demo button and badges beside a stage with a cut-out photo and floating mock UI cards, over a chip strip. Live: .epx-hero on the September 2026 solution pages (asset management, inventory, fixed asset, ITAM, tool tracking, equipment).

title.description: Title (the page H1). Line breaks are kept.

title_accent.description: Part of the title painted with the brand gradient.

badges.description: Compliance badges. Each: image, alt, and optional w, h (rendered size in px).

visual.description: The visual box, in px: w, h (the size the photo_box and cards were laid out in) and scale (phone scale step per breakpoint: keys 754, 736, 717, 667, 640, 614, 480, 430, 400, 360). On desktop the kit anchors the box bottom-right of the stage and scales it to a fixed 520px art height (at most 700px wide), so x, y and right are accepted for compatibility but no longer change the layout. Leave out a key to keep the asset-management value.

photo_box.description: Photo placement inside the visual box, in px: x, y, w, h.

cards.description: Floating mock UI cards. Each: slot (c1-c3 or f1-f3), below (sits under the photo), x, y, w (px in the stage box), flo_class (the card's own class), markup (the card body; sanitised by ap_ui_markup).

features.description: Chips in the strip under the stage. Each: label; icon_svg or icon (URL).

secondary_label.description: Optional second (green outline) button beside the first, e.g. Deal Registration. Renders only with secondary_url.

secondary_url.description: Second button destination (a page, #anchor, http(s) or mailto:).

badges_below.description: Badges in their own row under the buttons (32px apart) instead of beside them (Partners page). On phones the art then starts 10px under that row.

title_accent_fill.description: slice: the accent words carry their own gradient (the solution pages). heading: the gradient spans the whole title box, as Figma paints a gradient text range, so an accent that wraps reads green on its first line and indigo on its second (Partners: Join Our Reseller / Program).
